engineeringSkip.reason: Rebuilding atomic nuclei by steering quark-gluon plasma with laser lattices has no basis in known physics — quark-gluon plasma exists only fleetingly in colliders and cannot be shaped into stable matter.

factCheck.reason: Printing matter by rearranging atomic nuclei with laser-guided quark-gluon plasma has no basis in known physics — quark-gluon plasma exists only at trillions of degrees inside particle colliders, cannot be steered or held by lasers, and cannot be reassembled into chosen isotopes.
